  relation "attend classes at"
  role subject "Mateo"
  role object "Nagy Primary School"

  certainty asserted

  role subject "Alina"
  role object "Timișoara"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated

  role object "winter tyres"

  certainty asserted

  relation "go on a trip to"
  role subject "Nikos"
  role destination "Bistrița"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "fly to"
  role subject "Lucian Tănase"
  role destination "Craiova"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "go on a trip to"
  role subject "Iurie Rotaru"
  role destination "Bălți"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "attend classes at"
  role subject "Can"
  role object "Sighișoara Music Academy"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "stock"
  role subject "Brightfield Foods"
  role object "garden furniture"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s9 stated
  relation "stock"
  role subject "Tisa Textiles"
  role object "school uniforms"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s10 stated
  relation "train"
  role subject "Grace"
  role object "Cahul Wolves"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s11 stated
  relation "train"
  role subject "Zoltán"
  role object "Ploiești Falcons"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s12 stated
  relation "stock"
  role subject "Enache & Partners"
  role object "LED bulbs"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s13 stated
  relation "take care of"
  role subject "Octavian"
  role object "VPN gateway"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s14 stated
  relation "stock"
  role subject "Cluj-Napoca Logistics"
  role object "bicycle parts"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  mode count
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "go on a trip to"
    role subject "Bohdan Melnyk"
    role destination "Busan"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "fly to"
    role subject "Kavya Nair"
    role destination "Buzău"
    polarity negated
  end

@q3 query
  mode count
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "train"
    role subject "Nour"
    role object "Rapid Sibiu"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "take care of"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the analytics pipeline"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  except ?x "João"

@q5 query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "attend classes at"
    role subject ?x
    role object "Recife Music Academy"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q6 query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be on the payroll of"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Delta Print"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  except ?x "Priya"
